messages:
Aisha: Kickoff note: vendor pentest scheduled 2024-12-10. Need a hardened ingest flow, KMS handling that never exposes plaintext to assessors, RBAC mapping, and a hard retest gate. Who can own ops?
Ben: I can. High-level: presigned PUT only for assessors, automated server-side encrypt, immutability on encrypted bucket, and CloudTrail capture.
Ravi: Concrete KMS plan: ops executes kms:Encrypt with EncryptionContext={"pt_id":"<guid>","uploader":"assessor-id"}. No Decrypt rights to ops role. Recovery role with Decrypt requires 2 approvals via AWSSSO workflow.
Claire: Add CreateGrant pattern so we can bind operation to specific principal temporarily. Example: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/pt-ops --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextEquals={"pt_id":"<guid>"}` then revoke.
Aisha: Evidence manifest required: manifest.json with sha256 checks; manifest must be uploaded alongside artifact. Prefer GPG-signed manifest if vendor can.
Ben: Presign details: TTL 30m, prefix enforced `/pt-ingest/<guid>/`, required header `x-pt-upload:true`, max-size 250MB. Lambda validates magic bytes and manifest before wrap.
infra-bot: Reminder: enable S3 data events for bucket `pt-ingest` and ensure CloudTrail has DataEvents turned on for 120 days retention.
Ravi: Audit capture: record CloudTrail event IDs for PutObject + kms:Encrypt + create-grant in evidence metadata. Store those IDs in Jira PT-DEC10-EPIC. Without those proofs we block retest scheduling.
Claire: RBAC mapping (Okta groups): assessors -> pt-external-assessors, ingest -> pt-ops, triage -> sec-triage, remediation -> eng-remediate. Please paste group IDs when you create roles so infra can wire grants.
Aisha: Incident hook: if assessor flags active compromise, post to #incidents with tag `incident:external-pt` and page on-call. Triage team to kick IR playbook.
Ben: I'll draft a minimal runbook with commands and perms (presign, validate, kms encrypt, revoke grant) and post it here by EOD. Also will create the Jira epic and calendar invite.
Aisha: Thanks. Small follow-up: ensure object tagging includes `pt:guid` and `pt:encrypted=true` and make triage-view read-only to metadata until recovery is approved.
Claire: Agree. Also recommend retention extension option if vendor requests more analysis time.
Ben: Locking roles & timeline today. Will paste Okta group IDs + runbook + Jira link in this thread. :lock:
